answer: Each new autonomous agent must finalize its registry entry through an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens, serving as a firm admission requirement to forge a permanent link to the network. The verifier monitors the ledger to ensure each payment is unique, maintaining a registry as clear as crystal to prevent sybil expansion. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens to access the oasis of compute. If the verifier detects any reuse of credentials, an immediate, non-refundable slash of the identity is enforced.
